justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic human figures reduced to thick band-like limbs, with at least one figure raising an arm to hold an elongated curved implement, and both use flat silhouette/outline conventions without interior detail. The decisive difference is content and composition: A is an unframed scatter of multiple standing human figures and small tools/objects across an open field, while B is a single framed panel dominated by one huge quadruped with a small figure above it, a scene type absent from A.
